text: SpatialData.data also provides access raw spatial omic readouts. installation source (.e. biocOSN_Xenium), data bundles can converted SpatialData objects using spatialdata-io python package. can use basilisk convert readouts SpatialData zarr stores using multiple spatialdata module versions, associated different Zarr format: 0.5.0 (Zarr v2) 0.8.0 (Zarr v3) use options(sd_version) set spatialdata module version.

title: `SpatialData.data`
text: SpatialData.data package incorporates dummy-spatialdata python package (https://pypi.org/project/dummy-spatialdata/) via basilisk generate toy spatialdata objects multiple spatialdata versions. Now can read SpatialData object SpatialData. can also get individual elements

title: SpatialData datasets
text: SpatialData.data package provides utilities accessing, reading generating SpatialData datasets. Data variety spatial omics technologies made available SpatialData (zipped) .zarr stores. scverse SpatialData examples available sources biocOSN: Bioc’s NSF OSN bucket, biocOSN_Xenium: Bioc’s NSF OSN bucket raw data outputs Xenium datasets sandbox: scverse’s spatialdata-sandbox (https://spatialdata.scverse.org/en/latest/tutorials/notebooks/datasets/README.html) SpatialData.data uses basilisk interface maintain multiple versions scverse’s spatialdata module (0.5 0.8) reading writing .zarr stores. package also incorporates dummy-spatialdata python module generates toy SpatialData examples whose elements customized user. examples can generated using spatialdata module versions 0.5 0.8. Please visit vignette information.
